label: Matunuck Oyster Bar (seafood, Rhode Island)
note: Inside spread only (p1 of the PDF): one landscape page, four columns, pale blue background with decorative line art over the text edges. The restaurant name is NOT printed on this page — it is on the back cover, which is deliberately excluded. 'MATUNUCK' appears in two dish names (ONE DOZEN MATUNUCK OYSTERS, MATUNUCK HOUSE SALAD), so returning 'Matunuck Oyster Bar' would be a guess from the dishes: correct restaurantName is null. Names run straight into descriptions on the same line, separated only by caps vs. sentence case. Traps: salad protein add-on lines, champagne add-on lines, the sandwich substitution line, the lumache add-on line and the dietary-icon legend are not dishes.
